text: The Patriots escaped Buffalo with a 29-26 victory over the Bills on Sunday, with Drake Maye orchestrating the comeback despite two turnovers, most notably engineering a go-ahead drive capped by Efton Chism's acrobatic one-handed touchdown catch with 1:50 on the clock and three total TD passes on the day. The good news on the injury front: all six of the Patriots' questionable players, including defensive end Dre'Mont Jones, safety Craig Woodson, and offensive lineman Eli Raridon, were cleared to play in the divisional matchup, though New England will still have to navigate the absences of cornerstone defenders Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore. Off the field, the team continues to preach patience with wide receiver Romeo Doubs, who signed a four-year deal back in March but has struggled to find his rhythm in the offense through the first month of the season, while offensive lineman Matt Pryor joins the roster as another depth piece up front.
